description_for_human: Play chess against M365 Copilot via the MCP bridge.

functions.name: chess_read_board
functions.description: Returns the current chess position as Black: PGN history, the legal moves in SAN, both sides' pieces, and the FEN. Call before every move; also reports White's turn or game over.

functions.name: chess_make_move
functions.description: Plays Black's move (SAN or UCI) and updates the human's board. Refused if it is not Black's turn or the game is over; an illegal move returns the legal-move list to retry from.
